---

You manipulate the fabric of space-time, temporarily bringing two distant points together, connected by a magical gate. Choose two unoccupied 5-foot squares on solid ground that you can see within range. You create spherical portals in both squares that are 5 feet tall and 5 feet wide connecting the two locations. Any creature that enters one portal can immediately transport itself to the exit portal as a part of its move action, which adds the teleportation trait to its movement (this movement still triggers reactions as normal). Physical objects can pass through the portal normally, as though the portals were adjacent. Ranged attacks made through the portals treat them as only one 5-foot square for the purpose of calculating range. Spells cast through the portals have no effect.

---
**Heightened (6th)** Range increases to 500 feet, and the portals can be made up to 10 feet tall and 10 feet wide.

**Heightened (7th)** Range increases to 1,000 feet, and the portals can be made up to 30 feet tall and 30 feet wide.

When you do, your voice drops into a strange, ethereal register, and you speak a language that resembles a more fundamental version of Draconic. _Speak with magic_ doesn’t make them more friendly than normal. Though magic isn’t intelligent, you speak with the essence of the spell or magic item, which has a personality colored by the type of effect and its purpose as well as by the caster of the spell or creator of the item. A spell or magic item’s perspective, perception, and knowledge give it a worldview different enough from a human’s that it doesn’t consider the same details important. <row gap="medium">

<row gap="medium">

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 1 hour
</row>

</column>

---

Using ancient magic, you shape the words you speak into the primal sounds of water. You can ask questions of and receive answers from a body of water or the rain. While water isn’t intelligent, you speak with the natural spirits within the water, which have a personality colored by the type of water as well as the activity and movement of the water. Water’s perspective, perception, and knowledge give it a worldview different enough from a human’s that it doesn’t consider the same details important. Rain is fleeting and knows only what it’s currently touching. It can direct you toward unique silhouettes or structures or find a hidden place under a city as rain washes through the sewers. A body of water’s perspective is shaped by its size and age. A lake might remember when a fisherman drowned within them, but the ocean will likely only recall the most significant of events, such as a city sinking beneath their waves.

---
**Heightened (7th)** The duration is 8 hours.

You create a semicorporeal hand out of your essence that delivers touch spells for you. Whenever you Cast a Spell with a range of touch, you can have the hand crawl to a target within range along the ground, touch it, and then crawl back to you. When making a melee spell attack with the hand, you use your normal bonuses. The hand can move as far as it needs to within range. The hand has your AC and saves, but any damage to the hand destroys it and causes you to take 1d6 damage.

This abjuration reflects spells cast at you back at their caster. When a spell targets you, you can spend a reaction to attempt to reflect it. This uses the rules for counteracting the spell, but if the spell is successfully counteracted, the effect is turned back on the caster. Whether or not the counteract attempt is successful, _spell turning_ then ends. _Spell turning_ can't affect spells that aren't targeted (such as area spells).

 If _spell turning_ reflects a spell back at a caster who is also under the effect of _spell turning_, their spell turning can attempt to reflect their own spell back at you again; if they do so, their counteract attempt automatically succeeds.

You create one or more glowing protective runes that revolve around you. For each additional action you use when Casting the Spell, increase the number of runes you create by one, to a maximum of three runes for 3 actions. When you next take damage from a spell, a rune is expended to prevent 2d6 of that spell's damage. If damage from the triggering spell remains, additional runes are expended until the damage is completely negated, or until all runes have been spent, whichever comes first.

---
**Heightened (+1)** Each rune prevents an additional 1 damage.

fields.markdown:
**Source** [War of Immortals](/Sources.aspx?ID=232) pg. 141 **Area** 10-foot [emanation](/Rules.aspx?ID=2387) **Duration** 1 minute --- Magic surges to life around you, feeding on the raw power you radiate. Choose one of the following abilities to affect creatures in your aura. You can choose a different effect, ending the previous one, by [Sustaining](/Actions.aspx?ID=2317) the spell. You can [Dismiss](/Actions.aspx?ID=2311) the aura.
  • **Interference** The excess magic surrounding you creates a mental static. All saving throws against [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647) effects gain a +2 circumstance bonus.
  • **Mana Well** You become a source of pure magic that allows spells to be cast more freely. Allied creatures that would normally be required to attempt a flat check to Cast a Spell (such as from the [stupefied](/Conditions.aspx?ID=94) condition) automatically succeed.
  • **Overpower Resistance** Surging magic penetrates most defenses. Any time a spell affects a creature within the aura, that spell ignores an amount of the creature's [resistance](/Rules.aspx?ID=2318) equal to your level. This applies to all damage the spell deals, including [persistent damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=86) and damage caused by an ongoing effect of the spell. This doesn't cause the spell to ignore [immunities](/Rules.aspx?ID=1609).
  • **Ward Stray** magical energy diffuses damaging spells. Any time a spell affects a creature within the aura, the damage dealt by the spell is reduced by an amount equal to your level. This applies to all damage the spell deals, including persistent damage and damage caused by an ongoing effect of the spell.

Because _spirit blast_ affects the creature's spirit, it can damage a target projecting its consciousness (such as via [_project image_](/Spells.aspx?ID=237)) or possessing another creature even if the target's body is elsewhere. [Divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3)

**Lesson**
[Lesson of Life](/Lessons.aspx?ID=18)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 30 feet

**Target** 1 willing creature
</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 10 minutes
</row>

</column>

---

You form a spiritual link with another creature, taking in its pain. When you Cast this Spell and at the start of each of your turns, if the target is below maximum Hit Points, it regains 2 Hit Points (or the difference between its current and maximum Hit Points, if that's lower). You lose as many Hit Points as the target regained.

 This is a spiritual transfer, so no effects apply that would increase the Hit Points the target regains or decrease the Hit Points you lose. This transfer also ignores any temporary Hit Points you or the target have. Since this effect doesn't involve vitality or void energy, _spirit link_ works even if you or the target is [undead](/Traits.aspx?ID=160). While the duration persists, you gain no benefit from [regeneration](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=26) or [fast healing](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=15). You can Dismiss this spell, and if you're ever at 0 Hit Points, _spirit link_ ends automatically.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The number of Hit Points transferred each time increases by 2.

<actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Cantrip" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=22" />
<trait label="Hex" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=324" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
<trait label="Witch" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=323" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Divine Mysteries](/Sources.aspx?ID=234) pg. 299

**Patron Theme**
[Baba Yaga](/Patrons.aspx?ID=27)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 30 feet

**Target** 1 unattended object up to 1 Bulk
</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 1 minute
</row>

</column>

---

Using a sliver of [Baba Yaga](/Patrons.aspx?ID=9)’s power, you briefly bring a nearby object to life. The object gains a means of locomotion if it does not already have one, such as sprouting chicken legs, and [Strides](/Actions.aspx?ID=2305) up to 25 feet to a space you decide within range. Once per round, you can [Sustain](/Actions.aspx?ID=2317) the spell to command the object further, either prompting it to move again or to [Strike](/Actions.aspx?ID=2306). If prompted to move, the object Strides up to 25 feet again to a space within 30 feet of you. If prompted to Strike, the object attacks one creature of your choice adjacent to its space. Make a melee [spell attack](/Rules.aspx?ID=2248) roll against the creature. On a success, the creature takes 2d4 damage. The damage is either bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, as appropriate for the object. The object doesn’t do anything if it doesn’t receive further commands from you. If you cast _spirit object_ again, any previously affected object reverts back to normal. You can [Dismiss](/Actions.aspx?ID=2311) the spell.

---
**Heightened (+1)** Increase the maximum Bulk of the target by 1 and the damage by 2d4.

[Spirit of the Beast](/Spells.aspx?ID=1945)
<actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=721" />
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=561" />
<trait label="Flourish" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=606" />
<trait label="Focus" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=511" />
<trait label="Morph" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=657" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=676" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 67

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 30 feet

**Target** your animal companion
</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 1 minute
</row>

</column>

---

You bring out the spirit of another animal that lives within your companion. Its body morphs slightly to take on an aspect of the animal you choose to have it emulate—for example, it might grow a pair of horns if the spirit is a bull or a tail if the spirit is a monkey. When you Cast this Spell, select from one of the following aspects.

- **Aspect of Might** Your companion gains a +1 status bonus to [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) checks, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=40) checks to [Demoralize](/Actions.aspx?ID=2395), and Fortitude saves.
- **Aspect of Swiftness** Your companion gains a +1 status bonus to [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=34) checks, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=48) checks to [Hide](/Actions.aspx?ID=2404) or [Sneak](/Actions.aspx?ID=2405), and Reflex saves.
- **Aspect of Insight** Your companion gains a +1 status bonus to Perception checks to [Seek](/Actions.aspx?ID=2301), [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=49) checks to [Sense Direction](/Actions.aspx?ID=2406) or [Track](/Actions.aspx?ID=2408), and Will saves.

---
**Heightened (5th)** The status bonuses increase to +2.

**Heightened (8th)** The status bonuses increase to +3.

You open your mind to the metaphysical, enabling you to sense nearby spirits. ---

**Source** [Player Core 2](/Sources.aspx?ID=227) pg. 252 **Traditions** [Divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3) **Bloodline** [Aesir](/Bloodlines.aspx?ID=29) **Area** 60-foot cone **Defense** Fortitude --- Your eldritch song sends pulsing waves of ethereal energy to attack creatures' spirits in the area, dealing 14d6 spirit damage that causes their bodies to momentarily freeze up from the hypnotic nature of the tune, depending on the result of their Fortitude save. The vibrating waves of spirit song penetrate into, but not through, solid barriers, damaging [incorporeal](/Traits.aspx?ID=632) creatures hiding in solid objects in the area but not passing onward to damage creatures in other rooms. **Critical Success** The creature takes no damage.
**Success** The creature takes half damage and can't use reactions until the beginning of its turn.

Your eldritch song sends pulsing waves of ethereal energy to attack creatures' spirits in the area, dealing 18d6 force damage. Because _spirit song_ affects creatures' spirits, it can damage a target projecting its consciousness (such as via [_project image_](/Spells.aspx?ID=237)) or possessing another creature even if the target's body is elsewhere. The vibrating waves of spiritual song penetrate into, but not through, solid barriers, damaging incorporeal creatures hiding in solid objects in the area but not passing onward to damage creatures in other rooms. Possessed creatures aren't harmed by the song. The song doesn't harm creatures that have no spirit, such as constructs.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 2d6.

You draw on nearby spiritual energy or on echoes of the spirits you’ve invoked throughout your life to temporarily ward living flesh against dangerous spirits. You grant the target a +1 status bonus to saving throws against spells and effects caused by creatures that have the spirit trait and haunts. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters. 

<actions string="Single Action" /> The spell has a range of [touch](/Rules.aspx?ID=2238). 

<actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you target a living creature, the bonus increases to +2. 

<actions string="Three Actions" /> (concentrate) You create a ward in a 30-foot [emanation](/Rules.aspx?ID=2387). This targets you and all your allies in the burst.

You attune yourself to a spiritual plane of the Outer Sphere (see sidebar), connecting your spirit without fully transporting to it. Your Strikes and spells gain the alignment traits of the plane you chose, which deals additional damage to creatures with a weakness to either of those alignment traits. Furthermore, the plane protects you from energy of the alignments that oppose the plane. You gain resistance 5 to damage of the alignments that oppose those of your chosen plane. For example, if you chose [Heaven](/Planes.aspx?ID=17), your Strikes would gain the [good](/Traits.aspx?ID=83) and [lawful](/Traits.aspx?ID=99) traits, and you would gain resistance to chaotic and evil. If you choose the [Boneyard](/Planes.aspx?ID=15), the resistance is to negative and positive damage instead.

---
**Heightened (+2)** The resistance increases by 5.

<title level="3">The Outer Sphere</title> The nine main planes of the Outer Sphere are the homes of many deities, [celestials](/Traits.aspx?ID=23), [monitors](/Traits.aspx?ID=111), and [fiends](/Traits.aspx?ID=70). Their names, along with their alignments, are: [Heaven](/Planes.aspx?ID=17) (LG), [Nirvana](/Planes.aspx?ID=20) (NG), [Elysium](/Planes.aspx?ID=16) (CG), [Axis](/Planes.aspx?ID=14) (LN), the [Boneyard](/Planes.aspx?ID=15) (N), the [Maelstrom](/Planes.aspx?ID=19) (CN), [Hell](/Planes.aspx?ID=18) (LE), [Abaddon](/Planes.aspx?ID=12) (NE), and the [Abyss](/Planes.aspx?ID=13) (CE).

**Tradition**
[Divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2)

<row gap="medium">

**Cast** [somatic](/Rules.aspx?ID=283), [verbal](/Rules.aspx?ID=284)

 

**Requirements** You have a deity.
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 120 feet

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** sustained up to 1 minute
</row>

</column>

---

A Medium guardian made of magical force appears and attacks foes you designate within range. The spiritual guardian is translucent and appears to be holding your deity's favored weapon.

 When you Cast the Spell, the spiritual guardian appears in an unoccupied space next to a foe of your choice within range and makes a Strike against it. Each time you Sustain the Spell, you can move the spiritual guardian to an unoccupied space next to a target within range (if necessary) and make a Strike with it. The guardian uses and contributes to your multiple attack penalty. Alternatively, when you Sustain the Spell, you can have the guardian move adjacent to an ally and protect that ally. If you do, each time the ally would take damage, the guardian takes the first 10 damage instead of your ally. It continues to do so until you move the guardian to attack an enemy or defend a different ally, or until the guardian is destroyed (it has 50 Hit Points and can't recover Hit Points by any means). The guardian can't usually take damage except when protecting an ally, though [_disintegrate_](/Spells.aspx?ID=76) automatically destroys it if it hits the spiritual guardian's AC of 25.

 The guardian's Strikes are melee spell attacks. Regardless of the appearance of the guardian's weapon, the guardian deals force damage equal to 2d8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier, but you can deal damage of the type normally dealt by the weapon it holds instead of force damage. No other traits or statistics of the weapon apply, and even a ranged weapon attacks adjacent creatures only. Despite making a spell attack, the spiritual guardian's weapon is a weapon for the purposes of triggers, resistances, and so forth.

 The guardian takes up space and allies can use it when flanking, but it doesn't have any other attributes a creature would normally have aside from Hit Points, and creatures can move through its space without hindrance. The guardian can't make any attack other than its Strike, and feats or spells that affect weapons or enhance allies do not apply to the guardian.

---
**Heightened (+2)** The guardian's damage increases by 1d8, and its Hit Points increase by 20.

You launch a volley of splinters at your foes. Make a spell attack roll against a single creature. On a hit, the splinters deal 4d6 piercing damage. The splinters deal double damage on a critical hit and 1 [persistent bleed damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29). These attacks each increase your multiple attack penalty, but you don't increase your multiple attack penalty until after you make both spell attack rolls for _splinter volley_.

Memory alone isn’t always sufficient for charting an area. You concentrate on a blank piece of parchment in your possession and record the landscape and geographical features within range. The resulting map bears crude but recognizable symbols to represent structures, landmarks, and pathways but doesn’t label them.

---
**Heightened (6th)** The range of this spell increases to 10 miles, and major landmarks are labeled. A small star shows the spot where you are when the map is created.

**Area** a 5-foot cube

</row>

<row gap="medium">

---

Water blasts upward, coming out of the ground, rising from a pool, or even manifesting from thin air. Any creatures in the area take 2d4 bludgeoning damage, with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex saving throw. A creature that critically fails its save is disoriented by the explosion of water, becoming off-guard until the end of your next turn.

 You can change this spell's area to a 5-foot burst, provided you center the burst in a body of water. This body of water can be as small as a pond or creek, but not as small as a puddle or bathtub.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d4.

<actions string="Two Actions" />

<traits>

<trait label="Earth" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=585" />

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">

<row gap="medium">

**Area** 15-foot cone

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Defense**
Fortitude

</row>

</column>

---

A wave of purified salt burns away moisture and wickedness, dealing 5d4 acid damage. Each creature within the area must attempt a Fortitude save.

<column gap="tiny">

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature takes half damage.

**Failure** The creature takes full damage. If the creature has the [ooze](/Traits.aspx?ID=665), [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521), or [water](/Traits.aspx?ID=732) trait, it also takes 2d4 [persistent spirit damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=86).

**Critical Failure** The creature takes double damage, and double persistent damage if it has the ooze, unholy, or water trait.

</column>

---
**Heightened (+1)** The acid damage increases by 2d4, and the persistent damage on a failure increases by 1d4.

<title level="1" right="Spell 2" pfs="Standard">
[Spy's Mark](/Spells.aspx?ID=1296)
<actions string="Three Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Divination" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=47" />
<trait label="Scrying" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=141" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Firebrands](/Sources.aspx?ID=196) pg. 91

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3)

<row gap="medium">

**Cast** [material](/Rules.aspx?ID=282), [somatic](/Rules.aspx?ID=283), [verbal](/Rules.aspx?ID=284)

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** touch

**Target** a wall or other solid, immobile surface
</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 1 hour
</row>

</column>

---

By pressing your hand to a wall or other solid immobile surface, you cause the crossed-swords symbol of the Firebrands—or a different symbol of your choosing—to appear on the targeted surface. This symbol is immobile. You can use an action, which has the [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32) trait, to shut your eyes and focus on the symbol, projecting your senses into the symbol. While projecting your senses, you can see, hear, and smell through the symbol using whatever senses you have (including natural senses like [scent](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=33) and [darkvision](/Rules.aspx?ID=415) and magical senses like [_see invisibility_](/Spells.aspx?ID=271)). You must be within 100 feet to sense through the symbol in this way. You can Dismiss the projection effect but can otherwise freely project your senses into the symbol at any time during the spell's duration.

 A creature can erase the symbol (and end the spell) by spending 3 Interact actions to scrub the symbol away. These actions do not need to be consecutive.

---
**Heightened (4th)** The duration increases to 8 hours. You can sense through the symbol at a distance up to 500 feet away. Scrubbing the symbol requires 6 Interact actions.

**Heightened (9th)** The symbol remains until the next time you make your daily preparations. You can sense through the symbol at a distance up to 1 mile away. Scrubbing the symbol requires 1 total minute of work.

fields.text: Spell 2 Spy's Mark Three Actions Divination Scrying Source Firebrands pg. 91 Traditions Arcane, Occult Cast material, somatic, verbal Range touch Target a wall or other solid, immobile surface Duration 1 hour By pressing your hand to a wall or other solid immobile surface, you cause the crossed-swords symbol of the Firebrands—or a different symbol of your choosing—to appear on the targeted surface. This symbol is immobile. You can use an action, which has the concentrate trait, to shut your eyes and focus on the symbol, projecting your senses into the symbol. While projecting your senses, you can see, hear, and smell through the symbol using whatever senses you have (including natural senses like scent and darkvision and magical senses like see invisibility ). You must be within 100 feet to sense through the symbol in this way. You can Dismiss the projection effect but can otherwise freely project your senses into the symbol at any time during the spell's duration. A creature can erase the symbol (and end the spell) by spending 3 Interact actions to scrub the symbol away. These actions do not need to be consecutive. Heightened (4th) The duration increases to 8 hours. You can sense through the symbol at a distance up to 500 feet away. Scrubbing the symbol requires 6 Interact actions. Heightened (9th) The symbol remains until the next time you make your daily preparations. You can sense through the symbol at a distance up to 1 mile away. Scrubbing the symbol requires 1 total minute of work.

**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 164 **Traditions** [Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3) **Range** 100 feet **Area** 30-foot radius, 200-foot-tall cylinder **Defense** Will **Duration** [sustained](/Actions.aspx?ID=2317) up to 1 minute --- You replace the sky with a mesmerizing vision of the Astral Plane’s River of Souls, pulling creatures toward their final destiny. You can Cast this Spell only if you’re outside. All creatures in the area must attempt a Will save, and they repeat the save each time you Sustain the spell. **Critical Success** The creature is unaffected and temporarily immune to _stars of another sky_ for 1 day.
**Success** The creature is [fascinated](/Conditions.aspx?ID=72) by the beauty of the sky and rises 20 feet into the air. Creatures without a fly Speed remain in the air for the spell’s duration but fall when they recover from their fascinated condition. A creature that reaches the top of the cylinder doesn’t rise farther but takes 5d10 mental damage each time it starts its turn there due to a desire to become more immersed in the sky. Creatures without souls take double damage. If this damage drops the creature to 0 Hit Points, it dies instantly.
**Failure** As success, but the creature rises 50 feet into the air. Additionally, hostile actions don’t affect its fascinated condition for 1 round.
**Critical Failure** As failure, but the creature rises 100 feet into the air.

<title level="1" right="Spell 2" pfs="Standard">
[Steel Fortifications](/Spells.aspx?ID=2516)
<actions string="Three Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
<trait label="Metal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=505" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Battlecry!](/Sources.aspx?ID=268) pg. 90

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 120 feet

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 10 minutes
</row>

</column>

---

You conjure several metal structures that consist of angled beams attached to one another at a central point, which can help block attacks. You create up to three Large structures within range in unoccupied squares; each fortification is 8 feet long, 8 feet wide, and 8 feet tall. There must be enough room for a fortification in order to conjure it. A single fortification has an AC of 10 and is immune to critical hits and precision damage. It has [Hardness](/Rules.aspx?ID=2183) 9, 60 Hit Points, and a BT of 30. Once a fortification is [broken](/Conditions.aspx?ID=60), it crumbles into sharp metal bits. Any creature adjacent to or sharing a space with a fortification when it is broken must attempt a Reflex save or take 2d6 [persistent bleed damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=86). 

Creatures can pass through the spaces of a fortification, though Medium and larger creatures treat these spaces as [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=2366). A Small or smaller creature can occupy the same spaces as a fortification; doing so grants them standard cover. Similarly, a [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=88) Medium creature can occupy the same spaces as a fortification, gaining standard cover in the process. A Medium or smaller creature can climb a fortification with a successful DC 15 [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) check.

**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 164

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4)

<row gap="medium">

 

**Requirements** You have a free hand.
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** touch

**Target** 1 creature or object
</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 1 minute
</row>

</column>

---

The skin on your hand begins to ooze a strange adhesive that causes it to stick to a target. You and the target become inseparable for the spell’s duration or until the target [Escapes](/Actions.aspx?ID=2296). If the creature is smaller than you, it’s [immobilized](/Conditions.aspx?ID=81) and pulled along with you as you move. If the target is the same size as you, you’re both pulled along with each other as either moves, but you both treat all spaces as [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=2366). If the target is larger than you, you’re immobilized and pulled along as the target moves. You can [Dismiss](/Actions.aspx?ID=2311) this spell.

You conjure a jagged lance of stone and then launch it at a foe. Make a spell attack roll against the target. On a hit, you deal 6d6 piercing damage and the lance impales the creature, giving it a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds unless it [Escapes](/Actions.aspx?ID=79). On a critical hit, if the creature is on the ground, the lance also embeds into the ground and [immobilizes](/Conditions.aspx?ID=24) the creature until it Escapes. A creature that Escapes after being impaled takes 3 [persistent bleed damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29). When the spell ends, the lance crumbles into dirt, freeing the target if it hasn't Escaped.

---
**Heightened (+1)** Increase the damage by 2d6 and the persistent bleed damage for Escapes by 1.

You can ask questions of and receive answers from natural or worked stone. While stone is not intelligent, you speak with the natural spirits of the stone, which have a personality colored by the type of stone, as well as by the type of structure the stone is part of, for worked stone. A stone's perspective, perception, and knowledge give it a worldview different enough from a human's that it doesn't consider the same details important. Stones can mostly answer questions about creatures that touched them in the past and what is concealed beneath or behind them.

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 382 **Requirements** You are outdoors and aboveground **Area** 100-foot emanation, which includes you **Duration** sustained up to 1 minute --- The sky above you darkens in a matter of moments, swirling with ominous clouds punctuated by flashes of lighting. When you Cast the Spell and the first time you Sustain it each turn on subsequent rounds, select one of the following effects to occur in the area.
  • **Calm** No additional effect.
  • **Fog** Heavy fog rolls in, with the effects of [_mist_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1606).
  • **Rain** Torrential rain falls from the sky, dousing ordinary flames. Creatures in the area take a –2 circumstance penalty to [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) and Perception checks.
  • **Wind** Powerful winds buffet the area in all directions. Ranged attacks take a –4 circumstance penalty, and the area is difficult terrain for flying creatures.
In addition, once per round you can use a single action, which has the [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32) and [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104) traits, to call down a bolt of lightning, striking any target in range that you can see. You deal 10d6 electricity damage to the target; it must attempt a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save. On a failure, it is also [deafened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=8) for 1 round.

fields.markdown:
**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 374 **Tradition** [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4) **Spell Lists** [Elemental](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=5) **Bloodline** [Elemental](/Bloodlines.aspx?ID=6) **Deities** [Bokrug](/Deities.aspx?ID=568), [Nalinivati](/Deities.aspx?ID=313), [Sky Keepers](/Deities.aspx?ID=232) **Cast** [material](/Rules.aspx?ID=282), [somatic](/Rules.aspx?ID=283), [verbal](/Rules.aspx?ID=284) **Range** 800 feet **Area** 360-foot burst **Duration** sustained up to 1 minute --- A massive storm cloud forms in the air in a 360-foot burst. Beneath it, rain begins to fall, and gales impose a –4 circumstance penalty to physical ranged attacks and weapon ranged attacks, and the air in the area becomes greater difficult terrain for flying creatures. When you Cast this Spell and the first time each round you Sustain the Spell, you can choose one of the following storm effects. You can't choose the same effect twice in a row.
  • **Acid Rain** Each creature in the storm takes 4d8 acid damage with no saving throw.
  • **Hail** The storm deals 4d10 bludgeoning damage to creatures beneath it (basic Fortitude save).
  • **Lightning** Up to 10 bolts of lightning strike down, targeting creatures of your choice in the storm. No more than one bolt can target any one creature. Each bolt deals 7d6 electricity damage (basic Reflex save).
  • **Rain and Wind** Heavy rain and whipping wind reduce visibility and mobility, making the area under the storm cloud difficult terrain and making everything seen within or through the area concealed.
  • **Thunderclap** Each creature in the storm must succeed at a Fortitude save or be deafened for 10 minutes. A creature that succeeds is temporarily immune to thunderclaps from _storm of vengeance_ for 1 hour.
--- **Heightened (10th)** The range increases to 2,200 feet, and the cloud is a 1,000-foot burst.

fields.markdown:
**Source** [Player Core 2](/Sources.aspx?ID=227) pg. 252 **Tradition** [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3) **Deities** [Cthulhu](/Deities.aspx?ID=569), [Suyuddha](/Deities.aspx?ID=621), [The Enlightened Scholar's Path](/Deities.aspx?ID=251) **Range** 60 feet **Area** 4 cubes, each 10 feet on a side **Defense** Will **Duration** 1 minute --- You cause the areas to appear to swell, bend, and break, twisting together in a bizarre spatial geometry. The cubes of the spell's area can't be adjacent to one another. A creature must attempt a Will save if it's in one of the cubes when you Cast the Spell, or if it later enters one of the areas, with the following effects. A creature interacting with the illusion can also attempt a Will save to disbelieve the illusion, as normal. **Success** The creature disbelieves the illusion.
**Failure** All terrain in the cubes is [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=453) for the creature, including the air if the creature is flying, walls if it's climbing, and so on. When the creature would exit one of the cubes, it exits from one randomly determined by the GM. This is a [teleportation](/Traits.aspx?ID=710) effect. It can exit from any edge of that cube it chooses. When selecting a random cube, the GM excludes any that don't match the creature's terrain; for instance, if the creature were exiting along the ground, the GM would exclude any cube that didn't have an exit on the ground.

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 359 **Traditions** [Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3) **Deities** [Cormion](/Deities.aspx?ID=710), [Corosbel](/Deities.aspx?ID=418), [Droskar](/Deities.aspx?ID=447), [Erecura](/Deities.aspx?ID=564), [Lissala](/Deities.aspx?ID=565), [Mephistopheles](/Deities.aspx?ID=400), [Nalinivati](/Deities.aspx?ID=313), [Nyarlathotep (The Veiled Voice)](/Deities.aspx?ID=575), [The Tides of Chaos](/Deities.aspx?ID=698), [Titivilus](/Deities.aspx?ID=530), [Velgaas](/Deities.aspx?ID=601) **Lesson** [Lesson of Bargains](/Lessons.aspx?ID=34) **Range** 30 feet **Target** 1 creature **Defense** Will **Duration** varies --- You implant a subconscious suggestion deep within the target's mind for them to follow when a trigger you specify occurs (as described on page 303). You suggest a course of action to the target. **Source** [Secrets of Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=96) pg. 130 **Tradition** [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3) **Cast** [somatic](/Rules.aspx?ID=283), [verbal](/Rules.aspx?ID=284) **Range** 30 feet **Target** 1 creature **Saving Throw** Will **Duration** unlimited --- You place a bit of knowledge deep in a creature's subconscious or make a willing creature forget some information until a specific trigger occurs. The target gets a Will saving throw to resist the effect. A willing creature can choose to fail its save. **Critical Success** The target is unaffected and realizes you tried to alter its memory.
**Success** The target is unaffected but thinks your spell was something harmless instead of _sudden recollection_, unless it identifies the spell.
**Failure** You choose a piece of information the target didn't already know and create a trigger, such as seeing an object, hearing a key phrase, or witnessing an event. As soon as the target experiences the trigger, it receives the information and the spell ends. If the target was willing, you can instead choose a piece of information the target already knew and suppress its memory of that information until it experiences the trigger, after which it recovers the information and the spell ends.

**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 164 **Traditions** [Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4) **Range** 30 feet **Target** your familiar **Duration** [sustained](/Actions.aspx?ID=2317) up to 1 minute --- Sometimes, you need more allies to best you foes. Your familiar divides, turning into two familiars. Then they divide again, becoming four, then eight, and so on until there are innumerable copies of your familiar bustling about, eager to join the fight. While in its swarm form, your familiar gains immunity to precision damage and to the grappled, [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=88), and [restrained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=90) conditions; weakness 4 to area and [splash](/Traits.aspx?ID=699) damage; and resistance 4 to piercing and slashing damage. It occupies the space of a Large creature and can occupy the same space as other creatures. If your familiar is reduced to 0 Hit Points while under the effect of this spell, the spell immediately ends, and your familiar is instead reduced to 1 Hit Point. Once per turn, your familiar can use the Swarming Bites action.

**Swarming Bites** Each creature in the familiar swarm’s space takes 3d6 damage of the appropriate type ([basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2297) Reflex save). Usually this is piercing damage, but depending on your familiar, it can be bludgeoning or slashing at the GM’s discretion.

Upon Casting this spell, you immediately Command your familiar. The first time each round you Sustain this spell on subsequent turns, you Command your familiar as part of the same action. --- **Heightened (+1)** The damage of Swarming Bites increases by 1d6, and all resistances and weaknesses increase by 1.

It squeezes itself into its war form from time long forgotten, unleashing its wrath upon your foes. The Fleshforged occupies the space noted in the spell description. When you Cast this Spell, choose one of the Fleshforged below to summon.

- **Bone Breaker** _Size_ Gargantuan, _Speed_ 40 feet, climb 100 feet; **Arrive** _Skull Breaking Hum_ ([evocation](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1671), [sonic](/Traits.aspx?ID=147)) The Bone Breaker appears in a shower of bone fragments. Its form is that of an immense titan of flesh and metal with long, muscular, twisted arms. The Bone Breaker releases a hum at a harmonic frequency that weakens bones in creatures' bodies. Each foe within an 80-foot emanation must attempt a Fortitude save. On a critical success, they're  unaffected; on a success, they're [enfeebled 2](/Conditions.aspx?ID=13) for 1 round; on a failure they're enfeebled 3 for 1 minute; and on a critical failure, they're enfeebled 4 for 10 minutes. A [skeleton](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=92) or other [undead](/Traits.aspx?ID=160) foe made almost entirely of bones treats their result as one degree of success worse than they rolled. **Depart** _Bruising Departure_ The Bone Breaker pounds its long arms into the ground, creating a long shockwave. Each foe within a 100-foot-long, 10-foot-wide line takes 8d12 bludgeoning damage, with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude save.
- **Thorn Caller** _Size_ Gargantuan, _Speed_ 100 feet; **Arrive** ([evocation](/Traits.aspx?ID=65), [light](/Traits.aspx?ID=100)) _Thorn's Guidance_ The Thorn Caller appears in a burst of light. The Thorn Caller's body is an ornate armored sphere with black panther masks surrounding a glowing light. The ball floats in the air due to six glowing, thornlike wings. Two clusters of bird heads emerge from both sides of the body with long necks that twirl together like tentacles. The Thorn Caller's burst of light illuminates all foes within 200 feet. The foes become [dazzled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=7) and [flat-footed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=16), and if they were [invisible](/Conditions.aspx?ID=26), they become [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=4) instead. These effects last until the Thorn Caller departs. **Depart** _Thorn-Burst_ The Thorn Caller launches its thorned wings at various targets. Attempt spell attack rolls against up to 6 different targets within 300 feet. On a hit, the target takes 10d8 piercing damage, double on a critical hit, half on a failure, and none on a critical failure.
- **The Thousand** _Size_ Medium (see below), _Speed_ 30 feet; **Arrive** ([emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=60), [enchantment](/Traits.aspx?ID=61), [fear](/Traits.aspx?ID=68), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106)) _Disconcerting Arrival_ Select five spaces in range and summon a Medium-sized polyp of The Thousand in each of these spaces. The Thousand is an entity whose full scope is 1,000 polyps of oozing flesh, each physically separate but mentally part of a single creature. Not all 1,000 polyps have survived, and the spell summons five of them. Each creature within 10 feet of any of the polyps must attempt a Will Save. On a critical success, they're unaffected; on a success, they're [frightened 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=19); on a failure, they're frightened 3; and on a critical failure, they're frightened 4 and [fleeing](/Conditions.aspx?ID=17) for 1 round; **Depart** ([illusion](/Traits.aspx?ID=92), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106)) _Violent Omen_ Each frightened foe within a 60-foot emanation of any of the five polyps takes 10d8 mental damage, with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Will save.
- **Scion of Desiccation** _Size_ Gargantuan, _Speed_ 100 feet, fly 100 feet; **Arrive** ([necromancy](/Traits.aspx?ID=117), [negative](/Traits.aspx?ID=118)) _Ashes to Ashes_ The Scion of Desiccation appears in a swirl of screaming wind, a gargantuan form of twisted flesh that's constantly flensed by gritty ash and dust, and just as constantly regenerating itself. Each foe within a 40-foot emanation takes 10d10 negative energy damage, with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude save; **Depart** ([necromancy](/Traits.aspx?ID=117), [negative](/Traits.aspx?ID=118)) _Dust to Dust_ Each foe within a 60-foot emanation must attempt a Fortitude save; they're [drained 2](/Conditions.aspx?ID=10) on a failure or drained 4 on a critical failure.

You briefly call forth the spirit of a legendary wizard from ages long past, which manifests as an immense humanoid figure (typically an [elf](/Ancestries.aspx?ID=2) or a [human](/Ancestries.aspx?ID=6)). The archmage occupies the space of a Large creature and has a Speed of 60 feet.

 **Arrive** ([evocation](/Traits.aspx?ID=65), [force](/Traits.aspx?ID=75)) _Archmage's Amplification_ The archmage arrives in a fierce burst of magical force, automatically dealing 3d4+3 force damage to up to 5 creatures it chooses within 100 feet of it. Like [_magic missiles_](/Spells.aspx?ID=180), this can be blocked by the [_shield_](/Spells.aspx?ID=280) spell. The archmage also feeds magical power into some spells. Beneficial spells last longer due to the archmage's influence. When the remaining duration of a beneficial spell affecting you or one of your allies would decrease (usually at the start of the caster's turn), it doesn't decrease if the subject of the spell is within 100 feet of the archmage. This applies only if the spell's maximum duration was 3 rounds or longer. 

**Depart** ([abjuration](/Traits.aspx?ID=2)) _Archmage's Rebuke_ The archmage drains the magic from your foes. Each of your enemies within 100 feet of the archmage must attempt a Will save. On a failure, the creature is [stupefied 2](/Conditions.aspx?ID=37) for 1 round, and if it's currently benefiting from any spells of a lower level than _summon archmage_, the archmage can choose any one of them and end the spell.

fields.markdown:
**Source** [Secrets of Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=96) pg. 131 **Tradition** [Divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2) **Cast** [material](/Rules.aspx?ID=282), [somatic](/Rules.aspx?ID=283), [verbal](/Rules.aspx?ID=284) **Requirements** You have a deity. **Range** 100 feet **Duration** until the end of your next turn --- Your faith is strong enough to briefly summon a direct representative of your deity, such as the deity's herald. The herald occupies the space of a Huge creature and has a Speed of 60 feet. The effects of this spell depend on your deity's alignment.
  • **Lawful Good**: **Arrive** ([enchantment](/Traits.aspx?ID=61), [good](/Traits.aspx?ID=83), [lawful](/Traits.aspx?ID=99)) _Aura of Retribution_ While within 100 feet of the herald, you and your allies gain the champion's [Retributive Strike](/Actions.aspx?ID=5) reaction; **Depart** _Holy Smite_ The herald casts 5th-level [_divine wrath_](/Spells.aspx?ID=86) (choosing good) in a 100-foot emanation.
  • **Neutral Good**: **Arrive** ([enchantment](/Traits.aspx?ID=61), [good](/Traits.aspx?ID=83)) _Aura of Redemption_ While within 100 feet of the herald, you and your allies gain the champion's [Glimpse of Redemption](/Actions.aspx?ID=6) reaction; **Depart** _Merciful Healing_ The herald casts the 3-action version of 5th-level [_heal_](/Spells.aspx?ID=148) with a radius of 100 feet. This spell targets only you and your allies.
  • **Chaotic Good**: **Arrive** ([chaotic](/Traits.aspx?ID=25), [enchantment](/Traits.aspx?ID=61), [good](/Traits.aspx?ID=83)) _Aura of Liberation_ While within 100 feet of the herald, you and your allies gain the champion's [Liberating Step](/Actions.aspx?ID=7) reaction; **Depart** _Radiating Freedom_ The herald affects you and all your allies within 100 feet with [_freedom of movement_](/Spells.aspx?ID=128). The duration is reduced to 3 rounds.
  • **Lawful Neutral**: **Arrive** ([abjuration](/Traits.aspx?ID=2), [lawful](/Traits.aspx?ID=99)) _Defy Chaos_ You and each ally within 100 feet of the herald gain resistance 20 against chaotic damage while the herald is present; **Depart** _Order's Wrath_ The herald casts 5th-level [_divine wrath_](/Spells.aspx?ID=86) (choosing lawful) in a 100-foot emanation.
  • **Neutral**: **Arrive** ([transmutation](/Traits.aspx?ID=157)) _Quickening Ripple_ You and each ally within 100 feet of the herald are [quickened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=32) while the herald is present, and can use the additional action to Step, Stride, or Strike; **Depart** _Sapping Beam_ The herald casts 6th-level [_enervation_](/Spells.aspx?ID=687) in a 100-foot line.
  • **Chaotic Neutral**: **Arrive** ([abjuration](/Traits.aspx?ID=2), [chaotic](/Traits.aspx?ID=25)) _Defy Law_ You and each ally within 100 feet of the herald gain resistance 20 against lawful damage while the herald is present; **Depart** _Chaos Hammer_ The herald casts 5th-level [_divine wrath_](/Spells.aspx?ID=86) (choosing chaotic) in a 100-foot emanation.
  • **Lawful Evil**: **Arrive** _Aura of Iron_ While within 100 feet of the herald, you and your allies gain the champion's [Iron Command](/Actions.aspx?ID=552) reaction; **Depart** _Unholy Blight_ The herald casts 5th-level [_divine wrath_](/Spells.aspx?ID=86) (choosing evil) in a 100-foot emanation.
  • **Neutral Evil**: **Arrive** _Aura of Selfishness_ While within 100 feet of the herald, you and your allies gain the champion's [Selfish Shield](/Actions.aspx?ID=553) reaction; **Depart** _Infinite Despair_ The herald casts 5th-level [_crushing despair_](/Spells.aspx?ID=57) in a 100-foot cone.
  • **Chaotic Evil**: **Arrive** _Aura of Vengeance_ While within 100 feet of the herald, you and your allies gain the champion's [Destructive Vengeance](/Actions.aspx?ID=554) reaction; **Depart** _Weapon Hurricane_ The herald casts 5th-level [_weapon storm_](/Spells.aspx?ID=373) in a 100-foot cone, using d12 for the die size.
Herald Examples Each of the many deities of Golarion have their own herald; these are just a few of the most prominent.
  • **Lawful Good**: The Grand Defender ([Torag](/Deities.aspx?ID=18)), the Grim White Stag ([Erastil](/Deities.aspx?ID=6)), Hand of the Inheritor ([Iomedae](/Deities.aspx?ID=9))
  • **Neutral Good**: The Spirit of Adoration ([Shelyn](/Deities.aspx?ID=17)), Sunlord Thalachos ([Sarenrae](/Deities.aspx?ID=16))
  • **Chaotic Good**: Night Monarch ([Desna](/Deities.aspx?ID=5)), Thais ([Cayden Cailean](/Deities.aspx?ID=4))
  • **Lawful Neutral**: Lawgiver ([Abadar](/Deities.aspx?ID=1)), The Old Man ([Irori](/Deities.aspx?ID=10))
  • **Neutral**: Arcanotheign ([Nethys](/Deities.aspx?ID=12)), Personification of Fury ([Gozreh](/Deities.aspx?ID=8)), Steward of the Skein ([Pharasma](/Deities.aspx?ID=14))
  • **Chaotic Neutral**: The First Blade ([Gorum](/Deities.aspx?ID=7)), the Menotherian ([Calistria](/Deities.aspx?ID=3))
  • **Lawful Evil**: Basileus ([Asmodeus](/Deities.aspx?ID=2)), the Prince in Chains ([Zon-Kuthon](/Deities.aspx?ID=20))
  • **Neutral Evil**: Mother's Maw ([Urgathoa](/Deities.aspx?ID=19)), [the Stabbing Beast](/Monsters.aspx?ID=1007) ([Norgorber](/Deities.aspx?ID=13))
  • **Chaotic Evil**: Tarrasque ([Rovagug](/Deities.aspx?ID=15)), Yethazmari ([Lamashtu](/Deities.aspx?ID=11))

You momentarily summon an army of powerful dragons that unleash annihilating blasts as they descend upon your location. These dragons act as one and collectively occupy the space of a Gargantuan creature. They have a fly Speed of 100 feet. When you Cast this Spell, choose whether it summons [chromatic](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=34) or  [metallic](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=35) dragons.

 **Arrive** ([evocation](/Traits.aspx?ID=65)) _Energy Annihilation_ The draconic legion breathes out two blasts of energy: a 120-foot line and a 60-foot cone that can't overlap. Each creature in either of the areas takes 10d8 damage ([basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save). The dragons choose the damage type of each breath weapon, depending on the category of dragons summoned. Chromatic dragons can choose cold, fire, or poison for the cone and acid or electricity for the line; metallic dragons can choose cold or fire for the cone and acid, electricity, or fire for the line.

 **Depart** _Draconic Whirlwind_ The draconic legion strikes with fury, dealing 9d8 slashing damage (basic Reflex save) to all enemy creatures in its location or within 20 feet.

<title level="1" right="Spell 8" pfs="Standard">
[Summon Elemental Herald](/Spells.aspx?ID=1423)
<actions string="Three Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Incarnate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=388" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 222

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4)

**Spell Lists**
[Elemental](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=5)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 100 feet

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** until the end of your next turn
</row>

</column>

---

Your meditation into the different elemental planes connects you to them deeply, and this connection allows you to summon a herald of an [elemental lord](/DeityCategories.aspx?ID=8). The herald arrives in the form of a natural disaster centralized on your enemies. The herald occupies the space of a Huge creature. When you Cast this Spell, choose one of the elemental heralds below to summon; if you're a divine spellcaster who worships an elemental lord, you must choose the option matching your deity's element. This spell gains the trait ([air](/Traits.aspx?ID=5), [earth](/Traits.aspx?ID=55), [fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72), [metal](/Traits.aspx?ID=505), [water](/Traits.aspx?ID=165), or [wood](/Traits.aspx?ID=508)) matching your choice.

- **Air** Speed fly 60 feet; **Arrive** ([air](/Traits.aspx?ID=5)) _Supercell Front_ The herald of air arrives in the form of a twisting tornado, with high-speed winds slamming into your enemies. Each enemy in a 100-foot emanation takes 10d8 bludgeoning damage with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude save; **Depart** ([air](/Traits.aspx?ID=5)) _Twister Downdraft_ Each enemy in a 60-foot line must attempt a Fortitude save. A creature that fails is knocked [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=31) if it's on the ground or descends 40 feet if it's in the air. A creature that descends takes [falling damage](/Rules.aspx?ID=402) if this forced movement brings it to the ground.
- **Earth** Speed 50 feet, burrow 30 feet; **Arrive** ([earth](/Traits.aspx?ID=55)) _Tectonic Rise_ The herald of earth erupts from the ground, splitting it open in a 50-foot emanation. Each enemy in the emanation takes 10d6 slashing damage from the flying debris with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save. Enemies who critically fail [fall](/Rules.aspx?ID=402) 30 feet into the crevasse, taking falling damage (the sides of the fissure require successful DC 15 [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) checks to [Climb](/Actions.aspx?ID=33)); **Depart** ([sonic](/Traits.aspx?ID=147)) _Plate Crash_ The herald of earth sinks back into the ground, and the sides of the crevasse slam together with a deafening blow, dealing 5d10 sonic damage with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude save to all enemies in a 30-foot emanation. An enemy that critically fails is [deafened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=8) for 10 minutes.
- **Fire** Speed 60 feet, fly 40 feet; **Arrive** ([fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72)) _Magma Flow_ The herald of fire flows into the area as living magma, dealing 10d6 fire damage and 3d6 [persistent fire damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) to all enemies in a 60-foot emanation with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save; **Depart** ([fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72)) _Flame Vortex_ Each enemy in a 60-foot line takes 6d6 fire damage and 3d6 persistent fire damage with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save as the fire herald whips into a fire pillar before vanishing.
- **Metal** Speed 50 feet, fly 50 feet; **Arrive** ([metal](/Traits.aspx?ID=505)) _Shard Cloud_ The herald of metal arrives as a cloud of metal shards and static electricity, dealing 4d8 slashing damage and 4d12 electricity damage to all enemies in a 50-foot emanation with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save; **Depart** ([metal](/Traits.aspx?ID=505)) _Rust Mist_ The shards in the cloud rapidly rust and cling to enemies in the 50-foot emanation, dealing 10d6 damage to metal creatures and objects in the area with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save, ignoring Hardness. Unattended objects automatically critically fail this save.
- **Water** Speed 40 feet, swim 60 feet; **Arrive** ([cold](/Traits.aspx?ID=27), [water](/Traits.aspx?ID=165)) _Hurricane Formation_ The herald of water forms as a miniature hurricane. Each enemy in a 60-foot emanation takes 4d10 bludgeoning damage from the slamming rains and 4d10 cold damage from the falling hail with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude save; **Depart** ([cold](/Traits.aspx?ID=27), [water](/Traits.aspx?ID=165)) _Cataclysmic Deluge_ The hurricane collapses into a rushing flood, dealing 6d8 bludgeoning damage to all enemies in a 120-foot cone with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude save. A creature that fails its save is [pushed](/Rules.aspx?ID=451) 20 feet away from the herald (or 40 feet on a critical failure).
- **Wood** Speed 50 feet, burrow 30 feet; **Arrive** ([plant](/Traits.aspx?ID=125), [wood](/Traits.aspx?ID=508)) _Advantageous Roots_ The herald of wood bursts forth from the ground as a complex root system. Each enemy in a 50-foot emanation takes 6d10 piercing damage with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save as the roots skewer its limbs and body. Each enemy that fails its save takes a –10-foot status penalty to its Speeds until the herald departs; **Depart** ([plant](/Traits.aspx?ID=125), [wood](/Traits.aspx?ID=508)) _Retreat to Soil_ The roots retreat into the ground, dealing 6d10 piercing damage to each enemy in a 50-foot emanation with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save. Any creature with a penalty to Speeds from its initial save automatically takes 2d6 [persistent bleed damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29). The ground in the emanation is [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=453) after the roots retreat.

You call forth a servitor forged from raw positive energy to heal and bolster your allies. The servitor occupies the space of a Huge creature and has a speed of 60 feet.

 **Arrive** ([healing](/Traits.aspx?ID=89), [necromancy](/Traits.aspx?ID=117), [positive](/Traits.aspx?ID=128)) Servitor's Protection The servitor appears in a flash of light, moving from ally to ally and granting them a temporary reprieve. All allies within 20 feet of the Servitor gain 20 temporary Hit Points until the servitor departs.

 **Depart** ([healing](/Traits.aspx?ID=89), [necromancy](/Traits.aspx?ID=117), [positive](/Traits.aspx?ID=128)) Servitor's Blessing The servitor disappears in a 30-foot emanation of positive energy. All willing living creatures within heal 3d8 Hit Points. All [undead](/Traits.aspx?ID=160) within take that much damage, with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude save.

---
**Heightened (+2)** The Arrive effect's temporary Hit Points increase by 8, and the Depart effect's healing and damage to undead increase by 1d8.

You cast your spell, whisper your words of power, and find that an irii is already here—indeed, they have always been here, and always were, and always will be. The temporal being occupies the space of a Medium creature and has a Speed of 60 feet and a fly Speed of 60 feet. When you Cast this Spell, choose whether it summons a fate irii or a fortune irii.

- **Fate** The fate stands before you with its stained-glass wings and animal-headed gaze, floating eyes circling about it; **Arrive** ([divination](/Traits.aspx?ID=47), [fortune](/Traits.aspx?ID=76), [lawful](/Traits.aspx?ID=99), [prediction](/Traits.aspx?ID=132)) _Decree the Immutability of Time_ While within 30 feet of the fate, you and your allies who roll below 10 on a d20 for an attack roll, Perception check, saving throw, or skill check get a 10 instead; **Depart** ([divination](/Traits.aspx?ID=47), [misfortune](/Traits.aspx?ID=110), [prediction](/Traits.aspx?ID=132)) _Observe the Inevitability of Destiny_ Each enemy within a 30-foot emanation must attempt a Will save. If a creature fails its save, until the end of its next turn, any time it rolls above 10 on a d20 for an attack roll, Perception check, saving throw, or skill check, it  gets a 10 instead.
- **Fortune** The fortune stands before you with its golden horns and moth-scale wings, a sly smirk on its elfin face; **Arrive** ([chaotic](/Traits.aspx?ID=25), [divination](/Traits.aspx?ID=47), [fortune](/Traits.aspx?ID=76), [prediction](/Traits.aspx?ID=132)) _Decree the Chaos of Infinity_ While within 30 feet of the fortune, you and your allies roll twice and take the higher roll on all damage rolls, Perception checks, and saving throws; **Depart** ([divination](/Traits.aspx?ID=47), [misfortune](/Traits.aspx?ID=110), [prediction](/Traits.aspx?ID=132)) _Sunder Eternity's Authority_ Each enemy within a 30-foot emanation must attempt a Will save. A creature that fails its save must roll twice and take the lower result on all damage rolls, Perception checks, and saving throws until the end of its next turn.

<title level="3">Iriis</title> These denizens of the [Dimension of Time](/Planes.aspx?ID=21) are powerful guardians who ward the timeline against outside meddling, even as they war with each other over their divergent philosophies of time. An irii can be either a fate, with the view that time is immutable, or a fortune, with the opinion that time is fluid. Among practitioners of temporal magic, iriis are famed for their ability to see consequences before they occur, sidestepping them at their leisure.

You briefly conjure a kaiju, a massive, rampaging monster with a unique name and legendary reputation. It rises from its secluded lair to annihilate your foes. The summoned kaiju occupies the space of a Gargantuan creature. When you Cast this Spell, choose one of the kaiju below to summon.

<title level="2">Secrets of Magic</title>

- **Agmazar the Star Titan** Speed 100 feet, climb 50 feet; **Arrive** ([necromancy](/Traits.aspx?ID=117), [negative](/Traits.aspx?ID=118)) _Channel Void_ Each foe in a 100-foot emanation takes 16d8 negative energy damage with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude save; **Depart** ([transmutation](/Traits.aspx?ID=157)) _Gravitic Repulsion_ Each foe in a 50-foot emanation is [pushed](/Rules.aspx?ID=451) 100 feet away unless it succeeds at a Fortitude save.
- **Agyra, the Forever Storm** Speed 80 feet, fly 200 feet; **Arrive** ([electricity](/Traits.aspx?ID=56), [evocation](/Traits.aspx?ID=65)) _Breath of a Thousand Storms_ Agyra shoots two 1,200-foot lines of electricity, one from each of her heads. The lines can't overlap. Each creature along one of the lines takes 6d12 electricity damage with a basic Reflex save. On a failure, the creature is also [slowed 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=35) for 1 round (or for 1 minute on a critical failure); **Depart** ([evocation](/Traits.aspx?ID=65), [sonic](/Traits.aspx?ID=147)) _Thunderous Blast_ Each creature within a 100-foot emanation takes 6d10 sonic damage with a basic Reflex save, and is also knocked [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=31) on a failed save.
- **Bezravnis, the Inferno Below** Speed 100 feet, burrow 100 feet; **Arrive** ([earth](/Traits.aspx?ID=55), [evocation](/Traits.aspx?ID=65)) _Burrow from the Earth's Heart_ Bezravnis explodes from the ground where it was summoned, causing all creatures in a 50-foot emanation to take 8d12 bludgeoning damage with a basic Reflex save. This potentially collapses structures with the collapse effect of the [_earthquake_](/Spells.aspx?ID=95) spell, except there is no chance of falling into a fissure; **Depart** _Web Hurricane_ Bezravnis departs with a hurricane of webbing. All creatures within a 50-foot emanation must succeed at a Reflex save or take a –20-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds until it [Escapes](/Actions.aspx?ID=79) (or is [immobilized](/Conditions.aspx?ID=24) until it escapes on a critical failure). The Escape DC is your spell DC.
- **Mogaru, the Final King** Speed 100 feet, swim 100 feet; **Arrive** ([auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=16), [enchantment](/Traits.aspx?ID=61), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106)) _Trance of the King's Melody_ Mogaru manifests with a burst of the song that summoned him, requiring all foes within 60 feet who can hear him to attempt a Will save, leaving them [stunned 3](/Conditions.aspx?ID=36) on a failure; **Depart** ([evocation](/Traits.aspx?ID=65), [fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72)) _Volcanic Breath_ Mogaru unleashes his scorching breath in a 120-foot cone. Each creature in the area takes 10d6 fire damage with a basic Reflex save. On a failure, it also takes 4d6 [persistent fire damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29).
- **Vorgozen, the Shapeless Feeder** Speed 50 feet, climb 50 feet, swim 100 feet; **Arrive** ([necromancy](/Traits.aspx?ID=117)) _Pollute Magic_ Vorgozen's foul presence pollutes magic around her. Each of your enemies within a 60-foot emanation that are under the effects of a spell must attempt a Fortitude save. On a failure, the creature is [sickened 2](/Conditions.aspx?ID=34). Any of your enemies that Casts a Spell within 60 feet of Vorgozen must attempt a Fortitude save with the same effects unless it's already sickened; **Depart** ([acid](/Traits.aspx?ID=3), [evocation](/Traits.aspx?ID=65)) _Beam of Purest Vitriol_ Each creature in a 1,200-foot line takes 10d6 acid damage and 10d6 bludgeoning damage with a basic Fortitude save.
- **Yarthoon, the Moon Grub** Speed 60 feet, burrow 100 feet, fly 100 feet, swim 100 feet; **Arrive** ([cold](/Traits.aspx?ID=27), [evocation](/Traits.aspx?ID=65)) _Algid Beam Barrage_ Yarthoon fires countless beams, targeting each of your enemies within 200 feet of it. The beams deal 10d6 cold damage with a basic Reflex save; **Depart** ([cold](/Traits.aspx?ID=27), [conjuration](/Traits.aspx?ID=33), [water](/Traits.aspx?ID=165)) _Frostbite Mist_ Chilling mist surges out in a 100-foot burst centered on Yarthoon and remains for 1 minute. This mist has the effects of [_obscuring mist_](/Spells.aspx?ID=210), plus any creature within the area at the end of its turn take 5d6 cold damage with a basic Fortitude save.

<title level="2">Monsters of Myth</title>

- **Ebeshra, the Winged Razor** Speed 75 feet, fly 100 feet; **Arrive** ([conjuration](/Traits.aspx?ID=33), [teleportation](/Traits.aspx?ID=156)) _Planar Draw_ Each foe in a 100-foot emanation is pulled 50 feet towards the center, unless it succeeds at a Fortitude save. Creatures that fail and reach the center take 10d6 bludgeoning damage; **Depart** ([electricity](/Traits.aspx?ID=56), [evocation](/Traits.aspx?ID=65)) _Storm Discharge_ Each foe in a 240-foot line takes 12d8 electricity damage with a basic Reflex save

**Tradition**

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 30 feet

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** sustained up to 1 minute
</row>

</column>

---

While deities jealously guard their most powerful servants from the summoning spells of those who aren't steeped in the faith, this spell allows you to conjure an inhabitant of the [Outer Sphere](/Rules.aspx?ID=308) with or without the deity's permission. You summon a common [celestial](/Traits.aspx?ID=23), [monitor](/Traits.aspx?ID=111), or [fiend](/Traits.aspx?ID=70) whose level is –1 to fight on your behalf. Alternatively, you can choose a magical animal from the Outer Sphere as your lesser servitor. This animal is your choice of an [eagle](/Monsters.aspx?ID=172), [guard dog](/Monsters.aspx?ID=124), or [raven](/Monsters.aspx?ID=781). It gains the alignment matching your deity (or you, if you don't have a deity) and has the following trait depending on the alignment it gained: celestial for good, monitor for neutral, or fiend for evil.

 You can't summon a creature if it is opposed to your deity's alignment on either axis (or opposed to your alignment if you don't follow a deity). For example, if you deity is lawful good, you can't summon a chaotic or evil creature. The GM might determine that deities restrict specific types of creatures even if their alignments aren't diametrically opposed. For example, [Pharasma](/Deities.aspx?ID=14) would restrict the summoning of [sahkils](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=208).

 Heightening the spell increases the maximum level of creature you can summon and might add additional animal servitors, which otherwise work like the eagle, guard dog, and raven.

---
**Heightened (2nd)** Level 1.

**Heightened (3rd)** Level 2. You can summon a [black bear](/Monsters.aspx?ID=566), [giant bat](/Monsters.aspx?ID=46), or [leopard](/Monsters.aspx?ID=67).

**Heightened (4th)** Level 3. You can summon a [great white shark](/Monsters.aspx?ID=365) or [tiger](/Monsters.aspx?ID=69).

<actions string="Three Actions" />

<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=683" />
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=561" />

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [War of Immortals](/Sources.aspx?ID=232) pg. 157

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 500 feet

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** until the end of your next turn
</row>

</column>

---

You briefly summon the mythical Oliphaunt of Jandelay, unleashing a manifestation of pure destruction that obliterates everything unfortunate enough to stand in its path. The summoned Oliphaunt occupies the space of a Gargantuan creature. It has a Speed of 200 feet.

**Arrive** ([force](/Traits.aspx?ID=610)) _Devastating Displacement_ Using hidden magics and long-lost techniques, you conjure an immense gate to Jandelay, compelling the Oliphaunt to step through. The Oliphaunt arrives in a 60-foot [burst](/Rules.aspx?ID=2385). Each creature in the area takes 8d10 force damage ([basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2297) Reflex save). On a failure, the creature is also [pushed](/Rules.aspx?ID=451) 60 feet away from the Oliphaunt. 

**Depart** _Annihilating Trample_ The Oliphaunt becomes aware that it has been summoned to a world that isn't on the verge of annihilation. It summons another enormous gate to Jandelay 200 feet in front of it. The Oliphaunt then rages forward through the gate, crushing everything in its path, before closing the gate behind it and disappearing. The Oliphaunt creates an 80-foot-wide path of devastation that extends 200 feet. Each creature and vehicle in the area takes 8d8 bludgeoning damage (basic Fortitude save). A creature or vehicle reduced to 0 Hit Points is smashed into fine powder; its gear, passengers, and cargo remain. An unattended object in the area is destroyed unless it succeeds at a Fortitude save, regardless of [Hardness](/Rules.aspx?ID=2183), or unless it's an [artifact](/Traits.aspx?ID=537) or similarly hard to destroy. This trample automatically destroys any force effect, such as a [_wall of force_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1749).

This is an exception to the rule that summon spells do not normally allow you to adjust the level of the summoned monsters by applying adjustments or templates to them Tradition Primal Deities Aminara, Arundhat, Cyth-V’sug, Furcas, Granduncle Taproot, Green Man, Halcamora, Telvrys, Vermilion Mother, Xhamen-Dor Cast material, somatic, verbal Range 30 feet Duration sustained up to 1 minute You conjure a plant or fungus to fight for you. This works like summon animal , except you summon a common creature that has the plant or fungus trait and whose level is –1, such as those below. Heightened (2nd) Level 1. Heightened (3rd) Level 2. Heightened (4th) Level 3. Heightened (5th) Level 5. Heightened (6th) Level 7. Heightened (7th) Level 9. Heightened (8th) Level 11. Heightened (9th) Level 13. Heightened (10th) Level 15.

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 87 **Tradition** [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4) **Range** 120 feet **Defense** Will and [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex (see text) **Duration** until the end of your next turn --- You summon an unstoppable stampede of panicking beasts. Whether you conjure wild beasts or tamed cattle, the stampede is a force of nature that leaves behind nothing in its wake. The stampede occupies the space of a Gargantuan creature and has a Speed of 60 feet. **Arrive** ([emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=590), [fear](/Traits.aspx?ID=598), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647)) _Foreboding Tremors_ The sheer energy of a stampede can cause even apex predators to panic. Each creature within a 60-foot emanation must attempt a Will save with the following effects.
**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.
**Success** The creature is [frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=76) 1.
**Failure** The creature is frightened 2.
**Critical Failure** The creature is frightened 3 and [fleeing](/Conditions.aspx?ID=74) for 1 round. **Depart** _Flatten the Earth_ The stampede Strides up to double its Speed, trampling each Large or smaller creature, hazard, and structure whose space it enters, dealing 8d8 bludgeoning damage ([basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save). The stampede ignores and attempts to [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) all [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=2366) it enters caused by debris, overgrowth, rubble, or thick ground cover.

fields.markdown:
**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 87 **Tradition** [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4) **Range** 100 feet **Defense** see text **Duration** until the end of your next turn --- You briefly call forth the spirit of one of the [Wardens of the Wild](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=506), the legendary guardians of nature. The warden occupies the space of a [Gargantuan](/Rules.aspx?ID=2359) creature. When you [Cast this Spell](/Actions.aspx?ID=2734), you summon a warden depending on the biome in which the spell is cast (for instance, summoning the Warden of Caverns and Burrows if summoned in a cave, canyon, or other underground environment). In an unnatural environment, the warden summoned depends on the region's most recent or similar natural biome, as decided by the GM. - **[Warden of Caverns and Burrows](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3325)** Speed 60 feet, burrow 100 feet.
**Arrive** ([earth](/Traits.aspx?ID=585)) _Obsidian Cage_ Obsidian stalagmites burst from the earth as the warden surfaces, impaling enemies and trapping them in stalagmites. Enemies on the ground within 40 feet take 6d6 piercing damage ([basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save). Creatures that fail their save become [immobilized](/Conditions.aspx?ID=81) until they [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=2296) (the DC is your spell DC).
**Depart** ([earth](/Traits.aspx?ID=585)) _Blessing of the Depths_ The squares occupied by the warden remain disheveled and broken, becoming [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=2366). The warden affects you and all your allies within 60 feet with a [_mountain resilience_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1610) and [_unfettered pack_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1733). The duration for both spells is reduced to 3 rounds, but the duration of _mountain resilience_ isn't reduced when an affected target is hit by a bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing attack. - **[Warden of Forests and Meadows](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3326)** Speed 120 feet.
**Arrive** ([illusion](/Traits.aspx?ID=629), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647)) _Idyllic Panorama_ The warden's presence unpredictably warps the appearances and perceived distances of creatures and obstacles around it. Each time an enemy within 40 feet of the warden attempts a Strike or Stride action, it takes 4d6 mental damage ([basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Will save). On a critical failure, the creature Strikes a random target within reach or Strides in a random direction. On a critical success, the creature becomes temporarily immune for 1 round.
**Depart** _Fox's Insightful Trickery_ The warden affects you and all your allies within 60 feet with [_blur_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1455) and [_truesight_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1727). The duration for both spells is reduced to 3 rounds. - **[Warden of Oceans and Rivers ](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3327)** Speed 60 feet, swim 120 feet.
**Arrive** _I Am the Tide_ If the warden is summoned in a body of water, it creates a churning whirlpool that deals 10d6 bludgeoning damage to all creatures within 30 feet ([basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save). A creature that fails this save is [pulled](/Rules.aspx?ID=451) 15 feet closer to the warden (30 feet on a critical failure). If the warden is summoned outside of a body of water, it creates a wave of water that deals 8d6 bludgeoning damage to all creatures within 30 feet ([basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save). A creature that fails this save is pushed 10 feet away from the warden.
**Depart** _Acclimation to the Deep_ The warden affects you and your allies within 60 feet with [_feet to fins_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1525) and [_water breathing_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1755). The duration for both spells is reduced to 3 rounds, but a creature affected by _feet to fins_ retains its normal land Speed. - **[Warden of Peaks and Skies](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3328)** Speed 60 feet, fly 240 feet.
**Arrive** _Precipice Plummet_ The warden appears, flying downward from the sky and sends a shockwave where she lands. Creatures within 20 feet take 10d6 sonic damage ([basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude save). Creatures that critically fail their saves are [sickened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=91) 1.
**Depart** ([auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=541)) _Song of the Skies_ The warden affects you and all your allies within 60 feet with [_fly_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1534) and [_unfettered movement_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1732). The duration for both spells is reduced to 3 rounds.

<actions string="" />
</title>

<trait label="Necromancy" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=117" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Secrets of Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=96) pg. 135

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4)

<row gap="medium">

**Cast** 10 minutes ([material](/Rules.aspx?ID=282), [somatic](/Rules.aspx?ID=283), [verbal](/Rules.aspx?ID=284))

 

**Requirements** You have an eidolon.
</row>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** until your next daily preparations
</row>

</column>

---

You create a buffer in the link between yourself and your eidolon in order to prevent you from falling alongside your bonded ally. You gain the following reaction; after using it, the spell ends.

 **Sever Conduit** <actions string="Reaction" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32)) **Trigger** Your eidolon takes damage that would bring you to 0 Hit Points and comes from an effect other than a [death](/Traits.aspx?ID=40) effect; **Effect** You quickly shut the buffer in your link with your eidolon, causing your bonded ally to wink out of existence before you can be laid low. Your eidolon unmanifests, and you can't Manifest your Eidolon for 1 minute. In exchange, you don't take the triggering damage, though your eidolon still suffers any other adverse effects that accompanied the damage.

<actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Polymorph" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=127" />
<trait label="Transmutation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=157" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Secrets of Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=96) pg. 135

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4)

<row gap="medium">

**Cast** [somatic](/Rules.aspx?ID=283), [verbal](/Rules.aspx?ID=284)

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** touch

**Target** your eidolon
</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 10 minutes
</row>

</column>

---

You transform your eidolon into your identical twin. Assuming you are a humanoid, the eidolon gains the [humanoid](/Traits.aspx?ID=91) trait in addition to its other traits while it's in this form, as well as any other trait related to your form (such as [elf](/Traits.aspx?ID=58) or [gnome](/Traits.aspx?ID=80)). Your eidolon gains a +4 status bonus to [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) checks to [Impersonate](/Actions.aspx?ID=46) you and can add its level to such checks even if it's untrained.

 Although your eidolon looks like you, it doesn't gain any new abilities, and its statistics don't change in any way—the transformation is purely cosmetic. If this transformation reduces your eidolon's size, the eidolon loses any other effects of its larger size, such as any increase to [reach](/Traits.aspx?ID=192). Your eidolon can still use gear only if it has the [eidolon](/Traits.aspx?ID=386) trait, which allows eidolons to use it. Any such eidolon items the eidolon was wearing change size and shape, if necessary, and its effects remain active.

 You can Dismiss the spell.

---
**Heightened (4th)** The duration increases to 1 hour.
